notes.title: FREE PROLOGUE IS COMING!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Mall Simulator 2025 – Free Prologue is coming tomorrow! (July 30th) [/b]Don't forget to add it to your wishlist to be notified when it comes out! ⬇️[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3502270/Mall_Simulator_2025_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]WHAT’S DIFFERENT FROM THE DEMO?[/b]
This trial version includes performance improvements [b]plus 30 brand new STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] on top of the demo content![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164805/244f21a1c739cf1628bb95d6f45a6cfbcd20f351.png"][/img][/p][p][b]WHO SHOULD PLAY IT?[/b]
If you’ve played the demo before and want to try out new strategies, or if you want to collect [b]exclusive Prologue achievements[/b] for your profile – or if you’ve [b]never played the demo at all[/b], this is the perfect starting point![/p][hr][/hr][h3]And of course, I know many of [b]you are eagerly waiting for the Early Access main game[/b] version – [b]Mall Simulator 2025 will officially launch after the Prologue[/b], and I’ll be making a separate announcement for that! So stay tuned for this big release date! ❤️[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180150/Mall_Simulator_2025/"][/dynamiclink]If you haven’t added the [b]full game[/b] to your wishlist yet, now’s the time! ⬆️ I'm really excited about this!🔥[/p]

notes.title: SMOKERS & CATS?
notes.content:
[b]Now you can kick out customers who smoke in no smoking areas.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164805/ec71cd46cec1359ec7262a8695e439f85b6d4a2f.gif[/img]

[b]And who wants to throw sausages at our furry friends?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164805/eba0e021c6677baca57372627e0fe409b1a578be.gif[/img]

Every interaction with NPCs in the mall will [b]earn you Mall Points to boost you level up[/b]. It's all available in [b]early access[/b], don't forget to follow my other devlogs :)

Let's shape the game! [b]Join my Discord server[/b] to share all your excitement and feedback on Mall Simulator 2025! ❤️

[url=https://discord.com/invite/5JTj4sagMj][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45164805/13177dc42063d2c2cb464974da7dde1f6abededd.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: SAY HI TO RESTOCKERS!
notes.content:
[b]Tired of stocking? Hire a restocker![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164805/2cfd3b843874e6d1a5e11f6a6673784e85dd39e7.gif[/img]

[b]Restockers will pick up the boxes you left on the floor and fill your storage and empty shelves for you, I'm almost done with that! All will be available in Early Access, stay tuned : )[/b]

notes.content:

notes.title: DevLog #01 - Vending Machines!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! Welcome to the first post of my Mall Simulator DevLog Series, I will share all the design and technical developments of my game with you through this series![/b]

I guess you didn't think that a shopping mall would only have stores? Take a look at the vending machine mechanics I developed;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164805/52a23832d9b41fbaf38ccc94b089b725a30306ec.gif[/img]

Everything is going well, I hope you enjoy my devlog posts. Feel free to give me any feedback and comment.
If you want to stay up to date about my game Mall Simulator, [b]follow my Steam page and add to your wishlist![/b]
